name: Ingersoll Rand
description: Ingersoll Rand makes compressors, vacuum pumps and blowers that factories run on air and gas, plus precision pumps and liquid-handling and life-science equipment. A compressor is sold once and then serviced for 10 to 12 years; the 10-K says lifetime aftermarket revenue from one compressor typically exceeds its original sale price, and 36.5 percent of 2025 revenue came from aftermarket parts and service. It sells through its own sales force and independent distributors, and keeps buying niche businesses to add to the portfolio.

businessLines.name: Industrial Technologies and Services (ITS)
businessLines.how: Sells air and gas compressors, vacuum pumps, blowers, fluid transfer, loading systems, power tools and lifting equipment to plants (one-time equipment sale), then recurring parts, consumables and service over a 10-12 year machine life.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025, segment Adjusted EBITDA (not operating income)

businessLines.name: Precision and Science Technologies (PST)
businessLines.how: Sells specialised positive-displacement pumps, precision dosing and liquid-handling systems, gas compression and life-science tools to OEMs, EPC contractors and end users through distributors; qualified into customers' products so it is mostly repeat component and consumable orders.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025, segment Adjusted EBITDA (not operating income)

brands.name: Ingersoll Rand, Gardner Denver, Nash, CompAir, Elmo Rietschle (plus over 35 other brands)
brands.note: Primary brands of the ITS segment; no per-brand revenue disclosed.
